meta.source: (2024) Characterization of wing kinematics by decoupling joint movement in the pigeon. Biomimetics 9(9): 555, doi:10.3390/biomimetics9090555; Supplementary Data.zip (marker_data1-3.csv), via Europe PMC
meta.conditions: free flight in a 16 x 5 x 3 m arena, continuous flapping in level flight between perches (about 6 m/s), wingbeats 6-7 after take-off; body angles within 5 deg of level
meta.method: 30-camera infrared motion capture at 240 Hz (OptiTrack Prime 13; ~0.5 mm), markers on shoulder, elbow, wrist, carpometacarpus, P9 tip, S1, S10, body; three supplementary single beats x two wings; angles computed here from the marker positions (skin-marker error about +-5 mm on segment lengths); each wing fitted with 6 harmonics over its own period; means over the 4 wings of files 1 and 3
meta.phase_zero: maximum height of the P9 tip relative to the shoulder

arm_flap.description: elevation of the shoulder-wrist line above the body's horizontal plane, + up

hand_flap.description: elevation of the wrist-to-P9-tip line above the horizontal plane, + up

hand_rel_arm.description: hand line elevation minus arm line elevation (+ = hand above the arm's line)

tip_flap.description: elevation of the shoulder-to-tip line above the horizontal plane (stroke angle), + up

elbow.description: interior elbow angle between humerus and forearm marker lines (180 = straight)

wrist.description: interior wrist angle between forearm and carpometacarpus marker lines (180 = straight)

hum_elev.description: humerus (shoulder-elbow markers) elevation above the body's horizontal plane

hum_protr.description: humerus direction in the horizontal plane, + forward of the lateral axis

arm_sweep.description: shoulder-wrist line in the horizontal plane, + forward

hand_sweep.description: wrist-tip line in the horizontal plane, + forward (negative = swept back)

semispan.description: lateral distance of the P9 tip from the body midline

wristspan.description: lateral distance of the wrist from the body midline

tip_z.description: P9 tip height relative to the shoulder marker (body frame, z up)

tip_x.description: P9 tip fore-aft position relative to the shoulder (+ forward)

wrist_z.description: wrist height relative to the shoulder

wrist_x.description: wrist fore-aft relative to the shoulder (+ forward)
